Real payloads captured read-only from the bench Pi (build b26686c7) on 2026-09-27, trimmed to the fields the
dashboard reads. getClients.json has its DHCP addresses renamed. This device was, at capture time, in the
reference state: 3D GPS fix (14 satellites), 1090 receiving, external 978 radio connected with 0 messages,
no towers, every client asleep. Used only by the DashSource parsing test; nothing here is replayed to a live daemon.
